{"id":"example:kmp-demo:decision:retry-until-success","kind":"decision","text":"Checkout retries payment-provider calls until they succeed, to hide the provider's transient 5xx errors from customers.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101784106000:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101784106000:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":1},{"dimension":"component","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:component:checkout-api","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":1}],"metadata":{"document":"ADR-009 Retry on transient provider errors","source":"kmp-demo"}}

{"id":"example:kmp-demo:constraint:latency-budget","kind":"constraint","text":"Checkout must answer within 800 ms at p99. The payment provider's SLA takes up to 500 ms of that, so checkout-api's own work and its retries must fit in 300 ms.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101785834000:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101785834000:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":2},{"dimension":"component","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:component:checkout-api","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":2}],"metadata":{"document":"Checkout SLO review","source":"kmp-demo"}}

{"id":"example:kmp-demo:constraint:idempotent-payments","kind":"constraint","text":"Every payment call carries an idempotency key, so a retried call can never charge a customer twice.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101787216400:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101787216400:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":3},{"dimension":"component","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:component:checkout-api","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":3}],"metadata":{"document":"Payment provider integration guide v3","source":"kmp-demo"}}

{"id":"example:kmp-demo:observation:incident-2041","kind":"observation","text":"INC-2041: a provider slowdown turned checkout retries into a retry storm. Each customer request fanned out into up to nine provider calls, provider traffic tripled, and checkout p99 reached 1,400 ms.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101788359400:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101788359400:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":4},{"dimension":"component","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:component:checkout-api","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":4},{"dimension":"incident","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:incident:INC-2041","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":4}],"metadata":{"document":"INC-2041 postmortem","source":"kmp-demo"}}

{"id":"example:kmp-demo:decision:retry-cap","kind":"decision","text":"Retries from checkout-api to the payment provider are capped at two, with jittered exponential backoff; a third failure returns a retryable error to the client.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101788426000:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101788426000:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":5},{"dimension":"component","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:component:checkout-api","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":5},{"dimension":"incident","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:incident:INC-2041","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":5}],"metadata":{"document":"ADR-014 Retry budget for provider calls","source":"kmp-demo"}}

{"id":"example:kmp-demo:success_path:p99-recovered","kind":"success_path","text":"A week after the cap, checkout p99 fell from 1,400 ms to 620 ms and provider traffic returned to its August baseline.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101789030800:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101789030800:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":6},{"dimension":"component","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:component:checkout-api","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":6},{"dimension":"incident","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:incident:INC-2041","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":6}],"metadata":{"document":"Grafana checkout-latency dashboard","source":"kmp-demo"}}

{"id":"example:kmp-demo:decision:circuit-breaker","kind":"decision","text":"A circuit breaker opens after five consecutive provider failures and stays open for 30 seconds; the retry cap stays in place underneath it.","coordinates":[{"dimension":"timeline","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:timeline:timeline","occurred_at":"unix:101789894800:000000000","observed_at":"unix:101789894800:000000000","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":7},{"dimension":"component","scope_id":"label:v1:example%3Akmp-demo:component:checkout-api","ingested_at":"unix:101791328900:043829611","sequence":7}],"metadata":{"document":"ADR-015 Circuit breaker for provider calls","source":"kmp-demo"}}
